result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. Only one notable visual defect was found: the profile avatar in the top-right corner appears to be an empty placeholder circle rather than showing an avatar image or initials. All other partially visible items are expected carousel/viewport clipping behavior and were excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The profile avatar in the top-right corner is an empty gray circle with only a red notification dot; no avatar image, icon, or user initials are rendered inside it, making it look like a broken/unloaded image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the avatar image loads correctly, or provide a fallback (user initials or a generic person icon) inside the circle when no image is available.
